subject: FrostyPro 800 displaying error code on soft serve machine
description: The soft serve machine (SSM-0047-01) at the Vikhroli location is displaying an unidentified error code on its display panel, preventing normal operation. The machine was functioning normally until approximately 6:00 PM today when the error appeared. Staff attempted a simple restart but the error persists. No prior troubleshooting steps have been documented, and the specific error code has not been noted by the reporting staff.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Requested store staff to capture exact error code display and machine status for further diagnosis.
